views: view1: แปลนโครงหลังคาเหล็กสำเร็จรูป 1:200 — prefab trusses 001/005/008/009/010 (this file)
view2: แปลนแสดงแป C7575 — purlin layout, no marks (not extracted as elements; its 2.15 eave chain is in the grid master)
warnings: PT-02 is the ALTERNATIVE prefab cold-formed truss roof ('แบบระบบโครงถัก หลังคาสำเร็จรูปขึ้นรูปเย็น พร้อมเคลือบ Anti-corrosion Coating'; A-05: 'ให้เลือกทำโครงหลังคาเหล็กรูปพรรณ ... หรือเลือกใช้ระบบโครงหลังคาสำเร็จรูป'). The steel-section roof on S-07 (_หน้า41_view1_roof_frame_plan.json) is the other alternative; the two must not be summed.

Trusses are drawn as solid lines eave to eave, labelled with type numbers 001 / 010 / 009 / 008 at each hip end and 005 (41 lines) between; the printed chain '0.80 | 0.73 | 1.33 ...' places them at 0.60, 1.333, 2.667, 4.00 ... 62.667, 63.40 (grid master lines from this sheet, added with tools/gridfix.py). Each is one segment A-D (10.50, between the roof beams R7) with the 2.20 overhangs part of the member.

Not recorded as elements: the hip lines and the short unlabelled jack members at the hip ends (no marks), the dashed double end-wall lines at -0.20 / 64.20, the column squares, and the purlin plan 'แปลนแสดงแป C7575' (purlins 'แป C7575 @ 1.00 m', no marks). Purlin spec is on PT-03 (C75x35(37)x8.5x0.75 mm).

NOTE box on the sheet: 'Ensure roof bracing is installed in accordance with the Truss-Supplier Installation Manual. Lateral restraints (TOPSPAN40 / Top Chord material) continuing over adjacent trusses at 1.8m intervals are to be provided and braced to the ceiling plane.'
